dock.text: The ferry is here, {player_name}, engine ticking in the dark. The bell rope hangs just out of reach, and only someone the river has learned to trust can lower the ladder.

e_win.text: The bell rings out across the water. The ladder drops. Whoever is left on the far bank hears it, and starts to run.

e_lose.text: You walk until the sound of the engine is gone. Behind you, the ferry waits a while longer, and then it does not.
